My Jack Russell Terrier is one and a half years old. I was concerned about his habit of sitting with his hind legs spread wide and his front legs slightly bow-legged, so I consulted Miyu, a groomer and trainer.

For leg training, she carefully worked on a menu tailored to my dog, using tape, and my beloved dog seemed to be in a blissful state during massage time. After training, he returns to a dignified posture. I'm always grateful to the cheerful Miyu for her kind and attentive approach to any of my concerns.

My dog ​​is receiving leg training here.

My dog's hind legs were getting weaker, and he was walking unsteadily more often. I was wondering if there was anything I could do to help him when I came across this leg training program.

After a thorough consultation, we've only had two sessions so far, but his posture is much better and his gait is smoother.

They also clearly explain what to expect during the sessions and how to care for him at home.

The owner, Miyu, is very friendly and I felt that she has studied extensively based on her own experience.

If you're thinking about consulting about changes in your dog's body, I recommend talking to Miyu at M neige! She's not stiff or formal, and she'll explain things clearly.

I'm a regular customer every month ✨️
They always kindly listen to my requests and leave my hair feeling incredibly soft and cute 🌱

The difference in feel with and without the treatment is huge, so now I ask for a treatment every time!

I feel completely at ease coming here ✨️

My beloved toy poodle has been a client for many years.

They always leave her looking incredibly fluffy and cute, and the style lasts a long time without losing its shape. Not only are their grooming skills excellent, but they also genuinely put my dog ​​first and offer thoughtful advice on things like diet and daily care.

Thank you for your continued support. Mneige's cuts are amazing, and I always look forward to picking up my dog! He always comes home looking so fluffy (^^)! He also gives detailed instructions on how to care for your dog, which is very helpful. The owner is also very friendly, so it's a place I can visit with peace of mind✨

I always leave my pets to them, and they always end up with a really adorable finish🥰 Their grooming techniques are amazing, and they always tailor the style to suit each pet, so I'm very satisfied. They're also not just good at grooming, but they're also very dedicated to studying dog care and health, and I always learn from them. Since I started coming here, I've started to pay more attention to my dog's health, and I've come to care for them even more✨✨✨

This is the grooming salon my beloved toy poodle goes to every month.

I always leave everything to the owner-groomer, MIYU, and she always creates the cutest, ideal style for my dog ​​♡
I love the optional "Celebrity Course" because it leaves her dog exceptionally soft and fluffy, and the treatment effect lasts a long time.

Furthermore, she has extensive knowledge about dogs and provides comprehensive support, including advice on physical maintenance and diet!

My dog ​​used to be timid and disliked grooming, but ever since I started entrusting her to MIYU, she jumps into the shop every time we enter ♪
It's a wonderful salon that I would want to visit even if it meant traveling a long distance.

Thank you for your continued support!

Your knowledge, experience, and approach to animals are perfect, and I always feel completely at ease leaving my pet in your care.

Also, your skills are excellent, and thank you for always giving me the exact cut I want!

I've been coming here for almost two years now, and I look forward to continuing to use your services in the future. ⭐︎ Sometimes the groomer's beloved cat comes to the shop, and it's such a good and cute cat; as a cat lover, I'm always so happy when I get to see it! ♡

Our Pomeranian has been a customer for about two years now. We are always very satisfied with the cuts they give us, which are exactly how we want them to be! The groomers are also very kind and give us advice for our dog, and we can really feel their love for animals, so we feel at ease leaving our dog in their care! We look forward to continuing to use their services in the future♪
